 I scoured dozens of Black Friday sales, and these are the best style deals from Hoka, Kate Spade, Hanes and more
 There are thousands of Black Friday style sales already happening, but these are the best: We're eyeing Coach bags, Skechers, Crocs and other big brands for way less.
 Rebecca Carhart Follow Editor, Commerce Initiatives Updated Sat, November 21, 2026 at 2:11 PM UTC Our experts independently review everything we recommend. If you buy through our links, we may earn commission.
 Add to Preferred Sources Updated Sat, November 21, 2026 at 2:11 PM UTC Our experts independently review everything we recommend. If you buy through our links, we may earn commission.
 I'm a fashion editor, and you heard it here first: These are the only Black Friday style deals worth shopping. (Getty Images) If you've been holding out on a wardrobe refresh, the wait is over. The best Black Friday style deals are now live, and there are major markdowns on all your favorite brands. I'm talking Crocs, Coach, Hanes, Levi's and more, all at prices that'll make you do a double-take. If scrolling page after page of Black Friday deals sounds like a nightmare, don't fret. It's my idea of a good time, so I'm here to help you find the gems.
 Quick Overview

 Brooks Men’s Revel 8 Running Shoe ($65, was $100) : Save $35 
 Cate & Chloe Bianca Hoop Earrings with Swarovski Crystals ($13, was $27) : Save $14 
 See 32 more Want to live in leggings all season? Lululemon Aligns are 40% off. For the guys, a lightweight Patagonia jacket for half off is basically a no-brainer. And if your accessory game could use a glow-up, Kate Spade and Michael Kors Outlet are serving deals up to 75% off (yes, seriously). As your go-to fashion editor, I've sifted through all the offerings to curate a list of the best deals on clothing, accessories and shoes. So what are you waiting for? Scroll on to shop the best Black Friday style deals for men and women.  
 Top 5 Black Friday fashion deals
 Amazon
 Top menswear pick 
 Hanes Zip-Up Hoodie 
 $11 $28 Save $17 Save Need an extra layer as the weather gets cooler? Don't miss out on this soft fleece hoodie while it's down to $11 in certain colors. It comes in a range of shades, from classic black to forest green, and it's an Amazon No. 1 bestseller (one Yahoo editor gave the pullover version , also on sale, a ringing endorsement ).
 Great time to buy: This is close to the lowest price we've seen for this fan-favorite hoodie all year.
 $11 at Amazon Amazon
 Best womenswear pick 
 Levi's Women's 314 Shaping Straight Jeans 
 $38 $75 Save $37 Save This pair of straight-leg Levi's is basically the Old Faithful of denim. Can you wear sneakers or ballet flats with this cut? Sure. Ankle boots underneath? Absolutely. A knee-high boot over ? Why not? They're also available in short, regular and long sizes.
 $38 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $50 at Macy's $50 at JCPenney Lululemon
 Best editor-approved pick 
 Lululemon Align Leggings 
 $59 $98 Save $39 Save Sponsored by Lululemon 
 Take it from me, these are hands down the comfiest leggings you'll ever wear. They're ideal for low-impact workouts or just hanging out at home. These are probably the softest leggings I've ever worn, and they sculpt me in a super flattering way without feeling tight or restrictive. I love that they're sweat-wicking. And of course, they pass the squat test: I never have to worry about these leggings becoming see-through when I bend down.
 As you probably know, Lululemon leggings do not come cheap. If you've been wanting to try the brand's sought-after leggings without spending nearly $100 a pop, these top-sellers are up to 40% off (prices vary between colors). 
 $59 at Lululemon REI
 Best sneaker pick 
 Hoka Arahi 8 Sneakers 
 $105 $150 Save $45 Save Run, don't walk, to snag these cushy runners while they're 30% off. Designed with premium performance knit, a shock-absorbing midsole and ultra-lightweight cushioning, they're built to go the distance, whether you're logging miles or just powering through your daily steps.
 And in the ultimate goes-with-everything gray shade? They're easy to pair with everything else in your workout wardrobe.
 $105 at REI Walmart
 Best cozy pick 
 Fantaslook Plaid Flannel Shirt 
 $13 $21 Save $8 Save Are you also in your flannel era? Embrace the season in style with this comfy bestselling button-down, the perfect addition to any fall-to-winter wardrobe. It has a slightly oversized fit and a curved hem to flatter a variety of shapes, and it's ideal for layering on sunnier days and chillier nights. Yahoo readers love this pick so much that our own Julia Webb tried it , and she says the hype is real: "I was pleasantly surprised when I got my hands on these shirts. I didn't expect them to feel so soft — I can see why over 19,000 Walmart shoppers have given them five stars."
 $13 at Walmart Black Friday: Best womenswear deals
 Amazon
 Lillusory Cardigan 
 $14 $30 Save $16 Save A lightweight, slouchy cardigan is a fall wardrobe staple, and I love that this one has deep pockets to blend form and function. The generous length is perfect to pair with leggings well into the colder months.
 One reviewer raved, "So soft, true to size and the color is perfect. I plan to get other colors." And there are plenty to choose from: This cozy cardi comes in over 20 hues and in sizes XS to XXL.
 Great time to buy: It hasn't dipped lower all year, so now's the time to get cozy.
 $14 at Amazon Amazon
 Sinophant High-Waisted Leggings 
 $6 $10 Save $4 Save Yeah, I did a double-take when I saw the price, too — and the fact that these are Amazon's No. 1 bestselling leggings? Sold! Everyone needs a pair of these come boot season, since they can slide right into styles narrow and wide, and is there a more classic, comfy fall uniform than a slouchy sweater worn over these stretchy pants? I think not.
 Great time to buy: Grab a pair (or 10) while they're down to their lowest price in the past year.
 $6 at Amazon Amazon
 Wiholl Two Piece Set 
 $27 $34 Save $7 Save This two-piece set has that elevated, rich-mom look that makes simple loungewear read as surprisingly polished. The coffee shade, pictured, is especially chic (and your best savings), but the blue and black are also on sale and look just as luxe. It’s relaxed without looking sloppy, with an easy drape that makes it work for everything from airport days to coffee runs. And, yes, it'll make your lazy days at home feel a little more fabulous. Wear the pieces together for an instant outfit or split them up with your favorite basics.
 $27 at Amazon Nordstrom Rack
 Nordstrom Cashmere Crewneck Sweater 
 $60 $129 Save $69 Save We know a great cashmere sweater when we see one. This high-quality piece has a relaxed, easy-to-layer fit. Its timeless silhouette and breathable fabric make it endlessly versatile — the kind of piece you can wear year-round and style a dozen different ways.
 You may want to stock up on a few colors now that they're over 50% off. It comes in 21 (yes, 21!) colors, from neutrals to brighter hues that will make you just as dazzling as any fall foliage.
 $60 at Nordstrom Rack Amazon
 Anrabess Cardigan Sweater 
 $32 $50 Save $18 Save You don't need to bust out your bulky puffer coat just yet, but you'll need a stylish layering piece to keep you warm in the meantime. Reach for this “coatigan.” Part coat, part cardigan (yes, the name is real), it’s an easy layer for those days when a sweater feels too light but dressing like a duvet feels premature. 
 Great time to buy: Grab this endlessly versatile topper for the lowest we've seen it go in a year.
 $32 at Amazon Walmart
 Prettygarden Two-Piece Outfit 
 $32 $71 Save $39 Save This baby looks just like Oprah's favorite Spanx lounge set , which also happens to be a favorite of mine — but it's way more affordable than that $200-plus splurge and, frankly, has me questioning my life choices. The bestseller comes in 16 colors, and shoppers say it's incredibly soft and stylish (just like its more expensive counterpart). 
 $32 at Walmart Amazon
 Gloria Vanderbuilt Classic Tapered Amanda Jeans 
 $19 $52 Save $33 Save If you're always on the hunt for denim that makes you look and feel your best (and who isn't?), these top-sellers deliver, and they're 60% off. There's nothing more versatile than a flattering pair of blue jeans when it comes to any seasonal wardrobe — pair them with a tee for a casual look or a flannel button-down for a more stylish autumnal vibe.
 Great time to buy: Denim for under $20? Yes please — these classics are at the lowest price we've seen yet.
 $19 at Amazon Amazon
 Trendy Queen Oversized T-Shirt 
 $9 $15 Save $6 Save Cozy season is upon us and oversized, slouchy tops are the name of the game. This ultra-soft pick from popular Amazon brand Trendy Queen is available in 34 cute colors and prints and in sizes 3XS to 4XL. One reviewer (who repurchased three times!) said the "material is so soft and not see-through; great quality."
 Great time to buy : We wouldn't blame you if you stocked up on a few colors while the price is so low, but you'll snag the best deal on khaki and black.
 $9 at Amazon Marshalls
 Taylor Collared Ribbed Knit Midi Dress 
 $30 $60 Save $30 Save One-and-done outfits are my favorite kind, and this sleek sweater dress will make getting dressed look effortless. The soft ribbed dress has a classic collar, long sleeves and a midi length that makes it appropriate for everything from office days to weekend brunch. Even better? It's just $30 right now.
 $30 at Marshalls Amazon
 Hanes EcoSmart Fleece Sweatshirt 
 $17 $31 Save $14 Save You can grab this fan-favorite zip-up for as low as $17 in multiple colors, including this classic gray. It's made with cozy fleece that's not bulky, so you can wear it under a jacket on a chilly evening or on an airplane without adding too much extra weight. This discount won't last forever, so you might want to snag a few now. 
 $17 at Amazon Amazon
 Columbia Benton Springs Full-Zip Fleece Jacket 
 $39 $65 Save $26 Save With thousands of five-star ratings, this is an easy fall layer to add to your closet. It's made from filament fleece, which uses longer threads that resist pilling better than standard fleece, and it has a flattering shape that nips in at the waist.
 The stand-up collar, drawstring hem and roomy zippered pockets will keep the cold out. It comes in sizes up to 3X and dozens of colors.
 $39 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $45 at Backcountry $65 at Macy's Black Friday: Best menswear deals
 Amazon
 Hanes EcoSmart Fleece Crewneck 
 $8 $22 Save $14 Save Don't miss out on this soft fleece sweatshirt while it's up to 61% off. The No. 1 bestseller has over 108,000 five-star ratings, and you can choose from colors like black and navy blue — your best deal will be in this classic white, among a couple of others.
 Great time to buy: This is within a dollar of the lowest price we've seen for this popular pullover.
 $8 at Amazon Amazon
 Hanes Joggers 
 $12 $25 Save $13 Save Stay snuggly all day with these cozy fleece joggers. The tapered fit gives them a more tailored look, while the internal drawstring at the waist helps you find a comfortable fit. Choose from eight colors in sizes up to 3XL.
 $12 at Amazon Amazon
 Levi's 514 Straight Fit Jeans 
 $41 $75 Save $34 Save It's hard to go wrong with a good ol' pair of straight-leg Levi's. They're basically the denim equivalent of a good cup of coffee: reliable, timeless and somehow always there to make you feel better. They fit great, hold up wash after wash and look just as good dressed up as they do down. The button fly might feel old-school, but that’s part of the charm — it’s vintage without trying too hard.
 $41 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $65 at Target $50 at Macy's Amazon
 Carhartt Iconic K87 Pocket T-Shirt 
 $15 $20 Save $5 Save This classic tee is made from heavyweight cotton jersey, offering a mix of comfort, style and durability. Plus, it's currently 25% off, so now's the time to stock up on a couple for the season ahead. It has over 90,000 five-star ratings too. Said one happy customer : "Overall, it's a reliable, long-lasting T-shirt that delivers great value for the price and is perfect if you want something durable and simple."
 $15 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $20 at Lowe's Patagonia
 Patagonia Light Gust Hooded Pullover 
 $144 $289 Save $145 Save A Patagonia coat for half off? Your eyes aren't deceiving you! This pullover has lightweight recycled synthetic insulation, a water-repellent finish and an insulated hood. There's even a kangaroo pocket to keep your hands warm and toasty on chilly days. 
 $144 at Patagonia T.J.Maxx
 Levi's Relaxed Fit Sherpa Trucker Jacket 
 $40 $75 Save $35 Save This Levi's corduroy trucker jacket has a fuzzy sherpa lining that makes it much more appealing when temperatures start to dip. The relaxed fit makes it easy to layer things underneath, and at just $40, it looks way more expensive than it is. 
 $40 at T.J.Maxx REI
 The North Face Hydrenalite Down Hoodie 
 $187 $250 Save $63 Save If you want the warmth of a down jacket without the length of a parka, this is an excellent middle ground, and it's one of The North Face's top-selling down styles. It fits true to size, comes in a variety of colors and, most importantly, is insulated with 600-fill-power goose down and finished with a durable water-repellent coating to keep you warm and dry.
 $187 at REI Nordstrom
 Lands' End Bedford Rib Full Zip Vest 
 $42 $70 Save $28 Save Consider this your secret weapon for those in-between weather days when a jacket feels like too much, but going without isn't quite cutting it. This knit vest is lightweight and super soft, making it an easy layer to toss over everything from a crisp button-down to a cozy sweater.
 $42 at Nordstrom Amazon
 Under Armour Armour Fleece Twist 1/4 Zip 
 $46 $65 Save $19 Save This is the kind of layer that you want to keep within arm's reach for chilly morning walks, weekend errands and those lazy days when all you want to do is lounge around the house. The sporty quarter-zip looks good with both joggers and jeans, and the 30% discount makes it even easier to justify adding it to your cart. 
 $46 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $49 at Macy's $46 at Kohl's Amazon
 Wrangler Western Long-Sleeve Hoodie 
 $40 $53 Save $13 Save If you like your basics to have a little more personality, check out this Wrangler hoodie. The rope logo gives it western flair, so you can add a little cowboy-inspired style to your rotation without committing to a full-on boots-and-buckle-belt ensemble. 
 $40 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $53 at Lowe's Black Friday: Best accessory deals
 Crocs
 Crocs Classic Clog 
 $30 $50 Save $20 Save Sponsored by Crocs 
 Beloved by chefs, medical workers, gardeners and kids alike, these ubiquitous clogs are lightweight, easy to clean, quick-drying and water-friendly. The price varies based on the style and size you choose, but you can't go wrong with this neutral hue that's marked down to just $30 — that's an impressive 40% off.
 $30 at Crocs Kate Spade Outlet
 Kate Spade Lucy Wristlet 
 $29 $139 Save $110 Save This lovely little number has three credit-card slots and is big enough to hold your phone and maybe a little lip balm too. The strap makes it easy to grab and go, especially if you're the type who doesn't want to lug a big bag around town, and the pebbled leather keeps it feeling luxe.
 Great time to buy : Now's the time to stock up on this adorable wristlet while it's an eye-popping 79% off. It's available in 11 colors (prices vary) and would make the sweetest stocking stuffer.
 $29 at Kate Spade Outlet Amazon
 Adidas Women's Cloudfoam Sneakers 
 $35 $45 Save $10 Save If you're in the market for a pair of memory-foam kicks that'll keep you comfortable and supported all day long, behold these topselling Adidas sneakers with glowing five-star reviews from nurses, theme-park fanatics and people who are just constantly on their feet. Plus, their textile uppers wipe clean easily, making them even more practical. 
 $35 at Amazon Nike
 Nike Women's Cortez Sneakers 
 $45 $95 Save $50   with code Save Nope, you haven't magically time-traveled back to the '80s — these retro cuties are back in style, and they're celeb-approved . They're not heavy on the foot, but the footbed has ample padding to keep feet feeling sturdy and secure. Plus, the wider toe box means no crammed little piggies.
 Save $50   with code Copied! EARLYBF $45 at Nike Michael Kors Outlet
 Michael Kors Jet Set Large Pebbled Leather Camera Crossbody 
 $44 $258 Save $214 Save Save over $200 on this stylin' stunner, which features pebbled leather and an adjustable crossbody strap. You also get the security of a zip-top closure and a front pocket. It makes a great treat for yourself ahead of the holidays, or a sweet score for the stylish accessories queen in your life.
 $44 at Michael Kors Outlet QVC
 Skechers Women's Slip-ins Arch Fit Go Walk Joy Sneakers 
 $70 $100 Save $30 Save Sponsored by QVC 
 Whether you're trying to get your steps in or just running some quick errands, these slip-on sneakers are up to the task. They're outfitted with the brand's heel-pillow technology so they fit securely on your foot, and the high-traction outsole has lots of grooves and ridges to keep you steady on your feet. Now that they're 30% off, we suggest grabbing a pair before your size disappears, because comfort this good doesn’t stay discounted for long.
 $70 at QVC Amazon
 New Balance Women's Fresh Foam Arishi V4 Running Shoes 
 $51 $75 Save $24 Save New Balance quality at bargain prices? This is what Black Friday deals are all about. These trendy, versatile sneakers go with everything, from jeans to fall dresses, and at just over $50 right now, we'll definitely be adding 'em to our cart.
 $51 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $55 at Joe's New Balance Outlet $56 at Kohl's Coach Outlet
 Coach City Tote 
 $229 $295 Save $66 Save Looking for a new stylish work bag for the winter? This timeless tote is a stylish option with double-facing leather, a snap closure, two shoulder straps and an inside pocket to help keep you organized. Load it up with a wallet, sunnies, planner and tablet, and you'll still have room to spare.
 Whether you make it your new everyday bag or work tote (it can fit up to a 13-inch laptop), it's sure to go with practically any outfit, and it will never go out of style. You can't go wrong with basic black, but there are several other styles available.
 $229 at Coach Outlet Nordstrom
 Ugg Tazzette Genuine Shearling Collar Slippers 
 $70 $110 Save $40 Save "It's no secret that there's nothing cozier than shearling slippers, and this pair is a solid deal at $40 off," says Commerce Initiatives Editor Julia Webb . "Available in five colors, these are perfect for wearing around the house or, thanks to their traction sole, running out to the mailbox or wearing in the car after a day on the slopes."
 Great time to buy: "It's not very common to find Uggs on sale and in stock," says Webb. That said, many colors and sizes are going fast, so scoop 'em up, stat.
 $70 at Nordstrom Amazon
 Brooks Men’s Revel 8 Running Shoe 
 $65 $100 Save $35 Save Brooks running shoes are some of our experts' favorites , and reviewers agree: With nearly 1,600 five-star ratings, they love these relatively budget-friendly kicks for their support, cushy feel and easy stride. Our pros even rated some of the brand's kicks among the best walking shoes too.
 $65 at Amazon Walmart
 Cate & Chloe Bianca Hoop Earrings with Swarovski Crystals 
 $13 $27 Save $14 Save Hoops are a style staple, and these earrings certainly look way more expensive than they are, with 18-karat white gold plating and dazzling Swarovski crystals. They're hypoallergenic, with no lead or nickel. Grab a pair for yourself, your best pal, your sister ... the list goes on.
